documents.text: Refund window: purchases can be refunded within 30 days. Apply the product activation exception before approving a refund.
R01 refund exception: activated purchases are not refundable.
R02 refund exception: activated purchases require supervisor approval.
R03 refund exception: activated purchases receive account credit only.
R04 refund exception: activated purchases incur a ten percent fee.
R05 refund exception: activated purchases have a seven day refund window.
R06 refund exception: activated purchases must pass a usage review.
R07 refund exception: activated purchases need a signed return authorization.
R08 refund exception: activated purchases are refundable only after deactivation.
Delivery: shipping takes five business days. Tracking appears after dispatch; contact support if tracking has not moved for three days.
Invoice: download a PDF receipt from Billing. Invoice tax address corrections require a support request before month end.
Password: reset an account password using the email reset link. The link expires after fifteen minutes; request a fresh link if expired.
MFA: use a recovery code if the authenticator is lost. Without recovery codes, support must verify identity before resetting MFA.
Cancellation: cancel a subscription in Billing. Cancellation takes effect at renewal; access continues until the paid term ends.
Export: workspace owners can export conversation history as CSV. Export files expire after 24 hours.
Seats: workspace owners can add agent seats. Additional seats are prorated for the remaining billing period.
Webhook: failed event deliveries retry for 24 hours. Verify the signature using the webhook secret before processing an event.
